findings.claim: The new integration test imports `IggyBroker` from the crate root even though `frf-broker-iggy` does not re-export it there, so all-target test compilation fails.
findings.evidence: The test adds `use frf_broker_iggy::IggyBroker;`, while `crates/frf-broker-iggy/src/lib.rs` only exposes `pub mod broker;` and the diff adds no `pub use broker::IggyBroker;`; R1 requires `cargo check --workspace` clean and R2 requires all-target Clippy/tests compilation.
findings.suggested_fix: Either change the import to `use frf_broker_iggy::broker::IggyBroker;` or add `pub use broker::IggyBroker;` in `crates/frf-broker-iggy/src/lib.rs`.

findings.claim: Invalid watch configuration environment values are silently replaced with defaults instead of failing startup.
findings.evidence: `ENTITY_WATCH_CHECKPOINT_GENERATION`, `ENTITY_WATCH_RETENTION_SECONDS`, and `ENTITY_WATCH_BUFFER_CAPACITY` are parsed with `.and_then(|value| value.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(...)`, so malformed operator input is masked before `validation.rs` checks the resulting value; the reviewer mandate flags silent failure, and the acceptance requires advertised retention to derive from the same validated gateway value.
findings.suggested_fix: Parse these variables through a fallible helper that reports the variable name on parse failure, then validate the parsed value instead of defaulting on invalid input.
